info.title: GainingSocial Unified Social API
info.description: Social execution infrastructure for software and AI agents. All timestamps are UTC ISO-8601.

get.description: Returns 200 whenever the Worker can serve requests. Unauthenticated, and returns no tenant data. Does not check database connectivity.

x-request-id.description: Echoed request identifier. Quote this when reporting a problem.

x-trace-id.description: Trace identifier correlating this request across services.

apiKey.description: Project-scoped API key. Every authenticated route requires one.

x-error-codes.description: Stable, documented error codes. See docs/errors/.
x-error-codes.notFoundAndServerCodes:
- `PROFILE_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such profile.
- `CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such connection.
- `DESTINATION_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such destination.
- `MEDIA_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such media asset.
- `POST_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such post.
- `TARGET_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such publish target.
- `WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such webhook endpoint.
- `DELIVERY_NOT_FOUND` (404) — No such webhook delivery.
- `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (404) — The requested resource does not exist.
- `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` (503) — The social provider is temporarily unavailable.
- `PROVIDER_TIMEOUT` (504) — The social provider did not respond in time.
- `UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_ERROR` (502) — The provider returned an error we could not classify.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500) — An unexpected error occurred.
- `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (501) — This operation is not implemented yet.
